split_unit: geometric layout family; all groups derive from one source video
sampler: independently scrambled Sobol per group; pre-save all proposed parameters; take first N geometrically valid candidates

initialization.standard: same layout-conditioned initial tool origins and two initial arm IK poses as training; initial posture reveals sampled task geometry, including block bounds
initialization.disclosure: initial robot posture reveals starting task geometry; visual dependence requires counterfactual or image-shuffle evidence
initialization.geometry_acceptance: all six yaw-rotated blocks inside tabletop with 2mm margin, nonoverlapping block polygons with 1mm margin, block lower face 0 to 2mm above tabletop; computed before robot IK

test_ood_layout.axis_selection: one uniform Sobol coordinate selects an axis; every candidate forces that physical coordinate outside train support
test_ood_layout.other_dimensions: same continuous ID support; record selected OOD axis for stratified reporting

test_ood_dynamics.friction_note: block friction exceeds nominal table 0.5 and pan 0.55, so default max-mixing changes block contact friction

test_counterfactual.fixed: same nominal base, table, tools, robot joint qpos/qvel and visual parameters for all selected scenes
test_counterfactual.varied: block xy and yaw from the independent continuous ID layout sampler
test_counterfactual.disclosure: same robot proprioception can accompany different block layouts; this joint initialization-layout relation differs from the source teacher initializer

reporting.counterfactual_checks: identical robot-only qpos/qvel SHA256 within family; distinct block qpos; complete qpos differs because it includes free blocks
